subject: Partner credit issuance request — CloudShelf PLG top-up
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha@cloudshelf.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner credit request: CloudShelf PLG top-up

Hi Neha —

Hope you’re well. Quick ask from our Growth team: CloudShelf is seeing a spike in PLG signups from a recent integration post and they want to top up trial credits for a cohort of 1,200 accounts that signed during the promo window. The ask is for a one-time issuance of $12k in marketplace credits that will be passed through to end users (self-serve credit redemption).

We need Redwood’s approval to issue partner-funded marketplace credits and a CSV of voucher codes in the format your marketplace requires. Can you confirm the following?
- Acceptance of pass-through partner issuance for this cohort
- Any limits on per-account voucher amounts (we recommend $10/account)
- A contact for the CSV upload and the required fields for your marketplace

I’m attaching the intended voucher list (draft) and the promo terms that CloudShelf legal wants to reference. If you need a PO or signed paperwork we can get that in place; they want to avoid slowing the rollout.

Attachments: marketplace_voucher_list.csv (draft), promo_terms.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

—Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Partnerships, CloudShelf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@cloudshelf.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner credit request: CloudShelf PLG top-up

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the note and for the attachment. Quick answers up front: we can support partner-issued marketplace credits for self-serve redemption. A few operational items before we proceed:

1) Per-account cap: $15 max per account on marketplace redemptions for this program (we recommend keeping to $10 as you proposed).
2) CSV format: required columns are code, amount_usd, expiry_iso (YYYY-MM-DD), metadata (free-form). Please include an internal id column so we can reconcile.
3) Upload contact/process: I’ll hand the CSV to our marketplace ops team for upload. Please send the final file to marketplace-ops@redwood.ai with the subject line: CloudShelf_PLG_Topup_202612.

If the total partner commitment exceeds $10k we need a quick approval from Sales Ops for accounting (internal finance tagging); below I’m looping Jonas because he owns partner credits reconciliation. Camila, can you confirm we have margin/GL code for pass-through credits?

Assuming approvals: I’ll coordinate the upload and issue the vouchers with a 90-day expiry. If CloudShelf wants us to host redemption links in their onboarding flow, we can provide a redemption endpoint and an embed snippet.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner credit request: CloudShelf PLG top-up

Thanks Neha —

I’m okay with the flow and the $12k total for this campaign. Two operational notes:

- Please tag the expense to partner-promo-2026 (GL 5207).
- We need to make sure the vouchers are non-transferable and flagged for PLG signups only (we can enforce via metadata and redemption rules).

Rishi — can you approve the $12k booking? If we’re approving today we should let CloudShelf know so they can ship the final CSV.

Jonas
VP, Partnerships
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner credit request: CloudShelf PLG top-up

Approved.

I’ve reviewed the promo_terms.pdf and the reconciliation plan; $12k is fine. Please ensure:
- Promo_terms.pdf is attached to the deal record in HubSpot
- Marketplace-ops tags the upload with the HubSpot company id

Attaching the signed internal approval memo for finance (promo_terms.pdf).

Rishi
Head of Sales Operations
(attachment: promo_terms.pdf)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@cloudshelf.io>, CloudShelf Ops <ops@cloudshelf.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner credit request: CloudShelf PLG top-up

Hi Samantha —

Great — approved. Next steps:

1) Please send the final CSV (columns: code, amount_usd, expiry_iso, metadata, partner_id) to marketplace-ops@redwood.ai with subject: CloudShelf_PLG_Topup_202612. We’ll process the upload within 24 hours of receipt.

2) We’ll set per-code cap to $10 and expiry to 2027-03-05 (90 days). If any codes exceed $10 we’ll truncate to $10 at redemption; please avoid sending higher values.

3) For tracking and reconciliation, please include CloudShelf internal_id in the metadata column and confirm the HubSpot company id: 98765.

4) If you need the vouchers embedded in an onboarding flow, use this redemption endpoint: https://marketplace.redwood.ai/redeem?partner=cloudshelf (our engineers will provide a small JS snippet on request).

I’ve attached the signed promo_terms.pdf to the HubSpot record and created deal CS-PLG-2026-1147. Once ops confirms upload, I’ll send the issuance confirmation and a brief CSV reconciliation template.

Thanks — we’ll aim to have codes live by tomorrow EOD.

Best,
Neha
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
(attachment: marketplace_voucher_list.csv)
